verses.pali: Yo ca adhamme dhammasaññī, yo ca dhamme adhammasaññī.
verses.english: One who perceives what is not the teaching as the teaching, and one who perceives the teaching as not the teaching.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements grow.”
